propositions: jira_dc_pat fixture is function-scoped, minting a new PAT per test, exhausting Jira DC's 10-PAT-per-user cap when test count exceeds budget
PAT creation failure is misattributed to an unrelated test module because the error surfaces at the test that happens to run when budget is spent, not at the test that consumed it
changing jira_dc_pat to session scope reduces PAT consumption from O(tests) to O(1), scaling with test additions without re-approaching the cap
leftover tokens from crashed runs must be swept at session start via a defensive best-effort deletion of rebar-j5-harness-* tokens to prevent poisoning subsequent runs
the sweep must degrade safely: unreadable token lists yield empty results, failed deletes do not abort, and tokens lacking the harness prefix are never deleted
